capabilities: Publish, update and unpublish individual notes to Quartz 5 sites via the GitHub API
Manage published pages from a per-site panel with bulk update, move and cleanup actions
Rewrite wiki links, embeds and upload attachments in the published copy
Publish or unpublish several selected notes at once
Track per-note status (synced, modified, moved, source deleted) across sites
extras: Desktop-only. Stores the GitHub token in Obsidian's secret storage. Recommends keeping site repositories private because .pressroom/manifest.json reveals vault folder names. Not yet listed in Obsidian's community plugins at the time of writing; installation is via release downloads.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish selected notes to your own Quartz site without publishing the whole vault or adding frontmatter and markers to note files.

relations.evidence: Publish individual Obsidian notes to one or more Quartz 5 sites hosted in GitHub repositories.
Pressroom is desktop-only and works with Quartz 5 sites stored in GitHub repositories.

requires.name: GitHub token (fine-grained, Contents: Read and write)
A deployed Quartz 5 site in a GitHub repository

summary: Publishing tool that sends individual Obsidian notes to Quartz 5 sites hosted in GitHub repositories, with a management panel and no changes to note files.
